 Portugal immortalises Ronaldo with a new number 7
 Portugal’s national team has lined up in the iconic number 7 in its first match since Cristiano Ronaldo retired from international football. The country’s football federation also unveiled a permanent change to the number to mark Ronaldo’s historic 23-year career.
